with opencode on the PATH, setup runs:
  opencode mcp add factory -- roomctl mcp

otherwise: add this to opencode.json (roomctl setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "factory": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["roomctl", "mcp"]
      }
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in .agents/skills
and the /factory command (handoff, status, inbox) in .opencode/commands
